name: Cart Note
summary: Native order-note disclosure that composes one canonical Textarea while persistence remains target-owned.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native details disclosure for one cart-level note field.

anatomy.name: toggle
anatomy.description: Required native summary with a non-empty localized disclosure label.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Required complete canonical Textarea; its native field remains mounted when the disclosure closes.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size governed by the parent width and canonical Textarea.

states.name: closed
states.description: Native closed disclosure; the mounted Textarea content is hidden by details without losing its live state.

states.name: open
states.description: Native open disclosure exposing the complete canonical Textarea.

states.name: toggleFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the native disclosure summary.

behavior.name: nativeDisclosure
attributes: open on details establishes the initial static state
behavior.description: Native details and summary own static Web disclosure semantics, keyboard activation, hidden-content behavior, and the uncontrolled live open state.

behavior.name: textareaComposition
behavior.description: The required field contains one complete canonical Textarea and does not duplicate its label, value, native attributes, validation, message, resize, line bounds, or focus behavior.

behavior.name: nativeValuePreservation
behavior.description: Closing and reopening keeps the same mounted native Textarea, preserving its live value and control state.

behavior.name: targetPersistenceBoundary
behavior.description: The target chooses submission, blur, debounced input, or another persistence policy and owns requests, stale responses, cart refresh, errors, retry, and confirmed state.

behavior.name: targetStatusOwnership
behavior.description: Cart Note is not a live region. A target announces one contextual persistence result outside K10 only when an asynchronous outcome requires it.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Establishes the initial native open state in static Web or the controlled live state in a stateful adapter.

properties.name: field
properties.description: Required complete canonical Textarea that owns the sole note value, form, validation, resize, line-bound, and message semantics.

accessibility: Use native details and summary semantics or preserve the APG disclosure relationship in non-Web adapters.
Compose one complete Textarea with a visible associated label.
Keep the mounted note value and field state when the disclosure closes.
If persistence is asynchronous, announce one contextual target result outside Cart Note without making the component a live region.

web.notes: Native details/summary plus one canonical Textarea needs no Cart Note runtime; persistence and status remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: Optional editor-enabled cart-page snippet maps one canonical Textarea to cart.note and textarea[name=note] inside the native cart form; Ajax cart-drawer persistence remains target work.

react.notes: Adapter may bind live open state while Textarea and the target cart store retain value and persistence ownership.

figma.notes: Compose from a canonical Textarea instance with open and closed disclosure states; generic Button Studio nodes are not Cart Note artwork.
